memory_candidates.content: On Z-time (FrameOver intOrder), `phi S bot` is 'phi at t-1' and `phi U bot` is 'phi at t+1'. The closed L+ formula (q S bot) -> stab (q S bot) is valid on a regular Z-frame iff the frame is backward deterministic (unique step-predecessor); the forcing direction runs the singleton valuation |q| = {tau(t-1)}. This does not contradict deterministic_not_plusDefinable (cor:no-characterization), which is R-time and about full determinism: on dense time `q S bot` is unsatisfiable, so the formula is vacuously valid there.

Lean elaboration pitfalls hit in the 807 scratch: `omega` cannot use a hypothesis whose variable is bound at type `F.toTaskFrame.Duration` (bind it `(r : Z)`); `decide` fails to synthesize `DecidableEq` for an equality at type `F.toTaskFrame.WorldState` even though the carrier derives it (use `rfl`); `rw [F_step] at h` fails at reducible transparency when the variables are typed `F.WorldState` rather than the carrier (use `(F_step u w).mp h` term-mode).
